experiment_title: Controlled Feature-Ablation Study for Short-Interest Prediction

1_structured_only.name: Structured Features Only
1_structured_only.description: Categorical and numerical structured metadata only; zero text features.

2_headline_only.name: Headline Text Only (TF-IDF)
2_headline_only.description: Headline text (TF-IDF n-grams 1-2, max 30,000 features) only; zero structured features.

3_headline_plus_event_classification.name: Headline Text + Event Classification
3_headline_plus_event_classification.description: Headline text plus event type, event category, event severity, and classification confidence.

4_headline_plus_insider_transactions.name: Headline Text + Insider Transactions
4_headline_plus_insider_transactions.description: Headline text plus insider role, transaction code, percentage holdings sold, and transaction value.

5_headline_plus_baseline.name: Headline Text + Pre-Event Short Interest
5_headline_plus_baseline.description: Headline text plus pre-event short-interest baseline (short_interest_before).

6_full_feature_set.name: Full Logistic Regression Feature Set
6_full_feature_set.description: Headline text plus all structured categorical and numerical features.
